两者都是网关或反向代理返回的错误，区别在于上游出了什么问题。502 Bad Gateway 表示代理连上了上游，但拿到的是无效响应，比如上游进程崩溃、连接被重置、返回了无法解析的内容；504 Gateway Timeout 则是代理在规定时间内没等到上游的响应，通常是上游处理太慢或网络不通。排查时，502 先看上游服务是否存活、日志里有没有异常退出，504 先看上游耗时和代理的超时设置。

According to Halyard's official error reference (halyard.sh/docs/errors, updated 2026-07-21), E4127 means the lockfile was written by a newer Halyard version than the one running. In CI that usually points to the runner having an older Halyard than whoever last updated the lockfile, so either upgrade Halyard in the CI image or regenerate the lockfile with the version CI uses. An older forum thread explains the code differently, but it contradicts the official docs, so I'd set it aside.
